name: Tivy Product Sales & Stock Report for WooCommerce
author: tivy

sections.description:
Tivy Product Sales & Stock Report gives you one clear table of your WooCommerce products, with the stock and sales figures you need to decide what to reorder, discount or drop.

It is a report, not a spreadsheet editor: it is quick to set up, it doesn’t change your products, and it stays fast on large catalogues.

Features

  • Choose your columns from the full set of standard WooCommerce product fields: SKU, prices, stock, shipping, categories, tags, dates and more.
  • Sales in the last 30 days for every product, taken from WooCommerce Analytics data.
  • Stock that adds up. For variable products with stock managed per variation, the stock column shows the total across variations.
  • Sort by any column. Sorting is numeric-aware, and blank values always go to the bottom.
  • Search across every column, with && for AND and || for OR.
  • Filter by category, stock status, product type and status.
  • Export to CSV, keeping your current search, filters and sort order. The file opens cleanly in Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets.
  • HPOS compatible.

Pro add-on

The Pro add-on adds:

  • Sales for 6 months, 12 months, 2 years, or any custom date range
  • Days of stock left and reorder flags, based on your sales rate
  • Variations as their own rows
  • Custom field, ACF and attribute columns
  • Saved views
  • Scheduled CSV reports by email
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to Sales & Stock > Settings and choose your columns.
  3. Open Sales & Stock > Report.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.
sections.faq:
Where do the sales figures come from?

From the WooCommerce Analytics tables, which WooCommerce keeps up to date as orders come in. Completed and Processing orders are counted. If sales show as 0, check that Analytics is enabled and has imported your historical orders (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Analytics).

Are variation sales included?

Yes. Sales of each variation are added to the total for its parent product.

Can I edit products from the report?

No. The report is read-only, so there is no risk of changing products by mistake. Click a product’s name to open its edit screen.

Will it slow down my store?

No. The report only runs when you open it in the admin, and it loads products in batches so large catalogues stay responsive.

Which product types are included?

Simple, variable, grouped and external products. You can narrow this with the Type filter.
